component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.taskB = createObject("roSGNode", "TaskB") m.taskB.observeField("ready", "onTaskBReady") m.taskB.control = "run" end sub
sub onTaskBReady(event as object) if not event.getData() then return print "TASKB READY" ' TaskB's own m.global mirror is now seeded -- launch TaskA only after this point so the ' field it adds is guaranteed to arrive after TaskB's launch snapshot. m.taskA = createObject("roSGNode", "TaskA") m.taskA.observeField("marked", "onTaskAMarked") m.taskA.control = "run" end sub
sub onTaskAMarked(event as object) if not event.getData() then return print "TASKA MARKED" m.taskB.observeField("resultValue", "onTaskBResult") m.taskB.check = true end sub
sub onTaskBResult(event as object) print "TASKB RESULT: " + event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
